Released at 2026-10-19

* FEATURE: **Reads cut at the retention horizon: a query no longer plans a file that is past its retention, even before the eviction loop has deleted it.** One `retention.Policy` object (tenant overrides and rules included) now serves both the eviction loop and the read path, and it follows upstream VictoriaLogs/VictoriaTraces' day rule for a TTL of a day or more: a file is past its retention once the UTC day of its newest row is before the day of `now - TTL`, so nothing is hidden or deleted up to 23 hours early; a TTL below a day (a Lakehouse extension) stays exact. Every role cuts, so a select pod, which does not run the eviction loop, no longer serves data past its retention. Results change only for data older than its retention that eviction has not yet removed; there is no extra S3 request. Not cut: buffered (unflushed) rows, the tenant list and the stats and admin APIs (a tenant whose only files are past retention stays listed until eviction runs, [#619](https://github.com/ReliablyObserve/victoria-lakehouse/issues/619)). Raising a retention makes files that were hidden but not yet deleted visible again, and an alias-keyed tenant retention that resolves after start applies to the cut and to eviction alike only after a restart.
